Field Data Lab tests ideas from behavioral science on sports data. Sport is a good place to study
decisions: the stakes are real, the people are experienced, and almost everything is recorded.

Each article states its question, its data and its method, and links to the code so the analysis can be rerun.

Written by Anup Walvekar.
